plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: "charm pricing" OR "psychological pricing" OR "odd pricing" OR "price ending"
queries.rationale: Targets the direct evidence on whether price endings like $9.99 still influence consumer perception and conversion.

queries.query: "discount" AND ("brand equity" OR "perceived quality" OR "brand image") AND (ecommerce OR "direct-to-consumer")
queries.rationale: Finds empirical research on when and how price promotions damage brand value in online retail contexts.

queries.query: "ad creative" AND (conversion OR "click-through rate" OR "purchase intent") AND (testing OR experiment OR A/B)
queries.rationale: Catches studies that measure the impact of specific visual or copy elements in ads using experimental data.

queries.query: "product naming" OR "brand name" AND (choice OR preference OR "consumer judgment")
queries.rationale: Focuses on research testing how different naming conventions (descriptive, abstract, phonetic) affect consumer evaluation.

queries.query: "scarcity" AND (purchase OR conversion OR "checkout") AND ("limited quantity" OR "limited time")
queries.rationale: Targets evidence on the effectiveness and boundaries of using scarcity messages to drive e-commerce transactions.
Finds applied behavioral science interventions tested specifically in the online shopping funnel.

queries.query: "landing page" AND (optimization OR "conversion rate" OR testing) AND (headline OR "call-to-action" OR image)
queries.rationale: Searches for experimental findings on which specific page elements (copy, layout, visuals) most improve performance.

queries.query: "price testing" OR "pricing experiment" AND (ecommerce OR "online retail")
queries.rationale: Captures methodologies and results from field experiments on pricing in digital direct-to-consumer settings.

queries.query: "social proof" AND (conversion OR sales) AND ("customer review" OR testimonial OR "user-generated content")
queries.rationale: Targets quantified evidence on how different types of social validation (reviews, ratings, testimonials) impact sales.

queries.query: "free shipping" OR "shipping cost" AND (conversion OR "purchase decision" OR "order value")
queries.rationale: Finds research on the sales impact of shipping fee structures and thresholds, a key DTC lever.

queries.query: "visual attention" AND (advertisement OR "product page") AND ("eye tracking" OR heatmap)
queries.rationale: Catches studies using eye-tracking or other methods to show what visually captures consumer focus in marketing materials.

queries.query: "price framing" OR "partitioned pricing" AND (perception OR willingness-to-pay)
queries.rationale: Targets evidence on how breaking down total cost (e.g., product price + fee) versus bundling affects consumer response.

queries.query: "message framing" AND (promotion OR advertisement) AND ("gain frame" OR "loss frame")
queries.rationale: Finds comparative tests on whether emphasizing benefits (gain) or avoiding losses (loss) is more effective in marketing communications.

queries.query: "urgency" AND ("call-to-action" OR messaging) AND (ecommerce OR "online purchase")
queries.rationale: Searches for applied research on the effectiveness of time-pressure language ("act now", "today only") in digital contexts.

queries.query: "default option" OR "choice architecture" AND (subscription OR "checkout flow")
queries.rationale: Targets evidence on how pre-selected options or layout design in checkout/subscription flows influence final decisions.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan focuses on angles with direct, testable levers for a DTC growth marketer: pricing tactics, promotional effects, on-page elements, and behavioral nudges. Skips theoretical marketing models, brand equity theory, advertising history, and media/channel planning. Assumes the reader values quantified outcomes (conversion, CTR, sales lift) over qualitative or ethnographic insights.
